comingLast.roast: level with Leywood at the wrong end - the tension is real and hilarious
Smythe needs him to stay exactly this bad for 1 more holes
at 1.2 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
on 18 - the escape committee (his foursome) has convened
on 20 - the only man on the course playing match play against the bottom of the list
5 holes between him and a very memorable presso
2 points buys freedom - Smythe is pricing it higher by the minute
level with Smythe at the bottom - the blue balls may need a countback
safe by 1 unless the course gets generous late
finished 2 clear of the blue balls - now buying Smythe drinks out of gratitude
